sql: SELECT id, g, LAG(v, 1, d) RESPECT NULLS OVER w AS lag_column, LEAD(v, 1, d) OVER w AS lead_column, LAG(v, 2, CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN d - 1000 ELSE CAST(NULL AS INT) END) OVER w AS lag_case, LEAD(v, 2, CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN d - 1000 ELSE CAST(NULL AS INT) END) OVER w AS lead_case FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(v, -2, d) RESPECT NULLS OVER w AS lag_negative_respect, LAG(v, -2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lag_negative_ignore, LAG(v, 0, d) RESPECT NULLS OVER w AS lag_zero_respect, LAG(v, 0, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lag_zero_ignore, LAG(v, 2, d) RESPECT NULLS OVER w AS lag_positive_respect, LAG(v, 2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lag_positive_ignore, LEAD(v, -2, d) RESPECT NULLS OVER w AS lead_negative_respect, LEAD(v, -2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_negative_ignore, LEAD(v, 0, d) RESPECT NULLS OVER w AS lead_zero_respect, LEAD(v, 0, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_zero_ignore, LEAD(v, 2, d) RESPECT NULLS OVER w AS lead_positive_respect, LEAD(v, 2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_positive_ignore FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(v, 2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lag_default, LEAD(v, -2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_default, LEAD(v, 0, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_current FROM null_offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(v, 2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lag_default, LEAD(v, -2, CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN d - 1000 ELSE CAST(NULL AS INT) END) OVER w AS lead_case FROM empty_offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(CAST(v AS TINYINT), 1, CAST(d + 100 AS BIGINT)) OVER w AS lag_tinyint, LEAD(CAST(v AS SMALLINT), 1, d) OVER w AS lead_smallint, LAG(v, 1, CAST(d AS TINYINT)) OVER w AS lag_integer, LEAD(CAST(v AS BIGINT), 1, CAST(d AS BIGINT) - 2147483648L) OVER w AS lead_bigint, LAG(CAST(v AS DECIMAL(8, 2)), 1, CAST(d AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) OVER w AS lag_decimal FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

WITH s AS (SELECT id, d, CASE WHEN id IN (0, 4) THEN CAST(NULL AS INT) ELSE r END AS x FROM offset_scalar WHERE id < 6) SELECT id, LEAD(x, 2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_gap, LAG(x, -2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lag_gap FROM s WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(NAMED_STRUCT('x', v), 1, NAMED_STRUCT('x', d)) OVER w AS lag_struct, LEAD(NAMED_STRUCT('x', v), 1, NAMED_STRUCT('x', d)) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_struct FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(NAMED_STRUCT('x', d), 1, NAMED_STRUCT('x', v)) OVER w AS lag_struct, LEAD(NAMED_STRUCT('x', d), 1, NAMED_STRUCT('x', v)) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_struct FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(CAST(NULL AS SMALLINT), 1, CAST(d AS SMALLINT)) RESPECT NULLS OVER w AS lag_null, LEAD(CAST(NULL AS SMALLINT), 1, CAST(d AS SMALLINT)) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_null FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(v, 1, d) RESPECT NULLS OVER w AS lag_column, LEAD(v, 1, d) OVER w AS lead_column, LAG(v, 2, CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN d - 1000 ELSE CAST(NULL AS INT) END) OVER w AS lag_case, LEAD(v, 2, CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN d - 1000 ELSE CAST(NULL AS INT) END) OVER w AS lead_case FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(v, 2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lag_default, LEAD(v, -2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_default, LEAD(v, 0, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_current FROM null_offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(v, 2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lag_default, LEAD(v, -2, CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN d - 1000 ELSE CAST(NULL AS INT) END) OVER w AS lead_case FROM empty_offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(CAST(v AS TINYINT), 1, CAST(d + 100 AS BIGINT)) OVER w AS lag_tinyint, LEAD(CAST(v AS SMALLINT), 1, d) OVER w AS lead_smallint, LAG(v, 1, CAST(d AS TINYINT)) OVER w AS lag_integer, LEAD(CAST(v AS BIGINT), 1, CAST(d AS BIGINT) - 2147483648L) OVER w AS lead_bigint, LAG(CAST(v AS DECIMAL(8, 2)), 1, CAST(d AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) OVER w AS lag_decimal FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

WITH s AS (SELECT id, d, CASE WHEN id IN (0, 4) THEN CAST(NULL AS INT) ELSE r END AS x FROM offset_scalar WHERE id < 6) SELECT id, LEAD(x, 2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_gap, LAG(x, -2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lag_gap FROM s WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(NAMED_STRUCT('x', v), 1, NAMED_STRUCT('x', d)) OVER w AS lag_struct, LEAD(NAMED_STRUCT('x', v), 1, NAMED_STRUCT('x', d)) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_struct FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(NAMED_STRUCT('x', d), 1, NAMED_STRUCT('x', v)) OVER w AS lag_struct, LEAD(NAMED_STRUCT('x', d), 1, NAMED_STRUCT('x', v)) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_struct FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(CAST(NULL AS SMALLINT), 1, CAST(d AS SMALLINT)) RESPECT NULLS OVER w AS lag_null, LEAD(CAST(NULL AS SMALLINT), 1, CAST(d AS SMALLINT)) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_null FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, g, LAG(MAP('x', d), 1, MAP('x', v)) OVER w AS lag_nullable_default, LAG(MAP('x', v), 1, MAP('x', d)) OVER w AS lag_nullable_payload FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

WITH s AS (SELECT id, d, CASE WHEN id IN (0, 4) THEN CAST(NULL AS INT) ELSE r END AS x FROM offset_scalar WHERE id < 6) SELECT id, LEAD(x, 2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_gap, LAG(x, -2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lag_gap FROM s WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id LIMIT 3

SELECT id, g, LAG(MAP('x', d), 1, MAP('x', v)) OVER w AS lag_nullable_default, LAG(MAP('x', v), 1, MAP('x', d)) OVER w AS lag_nullable_payload FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

WITH s AS (SELECT id, d, CASE WHEN id IN (0, 4) THEN CAST(NULL AS INT) ELSE r END AS x FROM offset_scalar WHERE id < 6) SELECT id, LEAD(x, 2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lead_gap, LAG(x, -2, d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS lag_gap FROM s WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id LIMIT 3
SELECT id, LAG(r,1,d) OVER w AS dynamic_lag, LEAD(r,1,-1) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS literal_lead FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id
SELECT id, LAG(r,1,d) OVER w AS dynamic_lag, LEAD(r,1,-1) IGNORE NULLS OVER w AS literal_lead FROM offset_scalar WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id
SELECT id, LAG(ARRAY(CAST(r AS TINYINT)),1,ARRAY(d + 100)) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS x FROM offset_scalar ORDER BY id
SELECT id, LAG(ARRAY(CAST(r AS TINYINT)),1,ARRAY(d - 1000)) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS x FROM offset_scalar ORDER BY id
SELECT id, LAG(ARRAY(CAST(r AS TINYINT)),1,ARRAY(d + 100)) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS x FROM offset_scalar ORDER BY id
